obligations.behavior: ADR draft prompt planning reads the validated evidence ledger and parsed PRD, then produces a deterministic prompt plan containing bounded evidence summaries, PRD requirement summaries, material-decision guidance, output path metadata, and no raw file bodies.

The ADR draft prompt plan includes a deterministic idiom artifact command recipe using --prompt-file, --output, --json-out, --report-out, --no-tools, and --mechanical-repair without executing the command.

idiom product adr --render-prompt writes exactly the configured effort-relative prompt file, exposes JSON metadata, fails closed for missing or invalid evidence/PRD inputs and unsafe prompt/output paths, and does not write ADR markdown, ADR index, PRD, traceability, or evidence.

The ADR draft prompt rendering surface records only effort-relative paths, evidence/PRD identifiers, counts, command recipes, and typed findings in reports/state; durable workflow metadata does not embed rendered prompt bodies, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, or customer-identifying data.
obligations.command: privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts
